integrity: The infinite theorem is supported by a constructive combinatorial proof; finite checker confirms parameters 3 through 8. No independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Proved for two independent deleted cross edges and both bipartition parts at least three; excludes token sliding and nonminimum sets. The previously known minimum zero-forcing-set characterization is not claimed as new. Priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent literature.
title: The minimum zero-forcing reconfiguration graph of a biclique with two matching edges deleted
